name: flybudget
description: A fast, open-source budgeting app that gives you complete control over your financial data.

scripts.dev: concurrently --names client,server --prefix-colors cyan,yellow "npm run dev --prefix client" "npm run dev --prefix server"
scripts.electron:dev: cross-env ELECTRON_DEV=true concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names client,server,electron --prefix-colors cyan,yellow,magenta "npm run dev --prefix client" "npm run dev --prefix server" "wait-on tcp:3001 tcp:5173 && electron --require tsx/cjs ./electron/main.ts"
scripts.electron:build: npm run build:client:electron && npm run build:server:bundle && npm run compile:electron && electron-builder

author: David Tymoszenko
